author: @superm1

evidence.api_compatibility: No API compatibility impact. The change is purely in src/web-app/BuildWebApp.cmake (19 insertions, 0 deletions), which rewrites staged tsconfig moduleResolution values for the system-build path. No shipped API, schema, protocol, or integration behavior is affected.
evidence.documentation: No documentation changes needed. This is an internal build-system fix for packaging compatibility; it does not affect user-facing or developer-facing documentation.
evidence.manual_release_testing: Not in release surface. This is a build-system change to the CMake staging logic for system-nodejs packaging; it does not alter shipped behavior, CLI, GUI, or API. The change only affects how staged tsconfig files are rewritten during the system-nodejs-modules build path, which is exercised internally by the packaging CI.
evidence.post_approval_commits: No commits were added after the first (and only) approval from @fl0rianr at 2026-08-31T16:27:01Z. The PR had exactly two commits, both authored before approval.
evidence.review: PR #3186 received four substantive review comments from @fl0rianr (COLLABORATOR/maintainer) over two weeks. Initial review raised concerns about outDir removal and module rewrite side-effects. Second review caught a real blocker (TS5110: module must be Node16 when moduleResolution is Node16), noting transpileOnly does not skip this validation. Third review confirmed all concerns addressed and distro matrix was green. Final review approved the mergeable state with no remaining blockers. @kenvandine was requested as reviewer but never reviewed.
evidence.security: No security concerns. The change adds a CMake function that reads tsconfig JSON and does regex replacements on module/moduleResolution values. No credential handling, network calls, code execution, or supply-chain changes.
evidence.tests: No new test files added, but the change is build-configuration only. Full CI green across 60+ checks including: Linux Distro Builds (Arch, openSUSE), C++ Server Build with .deb packaging (Debian 13 on x86_64 and ARM64), Fedora .rpm builds (43 and 44 on x86_64 and ARM64), Launchpad PPA builds (Ubuntu 24.04/25.10/26.04 on x86_64 and ARM64), container builds (amd64 and arm64), CodeQL analysis, app regression tests, pre-commit, markdown-link-check, and server endpoint/API tests. Debian-specific sbuild testing was also performed by the author.

shout_outs.reason: Provided four rounds of substantive review across two weeks, identified a real blocker (TS5110 module/moduleResolution incompatibility), validated the fix across the full distro matrix (Ubuntu 24.04/25.10/26.04 on both x86_64 and ARM64), and drove the solution to a clean resolution.

subject: Switch to bundler module resolution for tsconfig (#3186)
summary: Adds a CMake function to rewrite staged tsconfig moduleResolution to node16 for system package builds, fixing a Debian FTBFS caused by TypeScript version incompatibility across distros.
verdict_reason: Narrowly scoped build fix with comprehensive multi-distro CI coverage and thorough iterative review from a maintainer with CI subject-matter expertise.
